work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act praises the Cavanis brothers' charity schools in Venice and sends each a gold medal. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF7131; own dating clause LF7213–7216 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem die decima tertia augusti anni millesimi octingentesimi trigesimi primi, pontificatus No- stri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF7183 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
